applied_identity_correction.title: Apollo Belvedere (SMK Plaster Cast, KAS353)
applied_identity_correction.note: SMK KAS353 is a plaster cast of the Apollo Belvedere, acquired in 1897. SMK records a Paris/Louvre mould source; the acquisition year does not establish when this cast was made. The represented Roman marble is in the Vatican Museums. The traditional Leochares attribution concerns the ancient type, not a known maker of this plaster cast.

correction.title: Lion (SMK Plaster Cast, KAS1016)
correction.note: SMK KAS1016 is a plaster cast acquired in 1901 after a tomb lion from Xanthos, associated with the Nereid Monument and dated approximately 390 BCE. The represented ancient marble is now in the British Museum. SMK does not document this cast's maker or manufacture date; 1901 is its acquisition year. The museum's small STL matches the catalog source file's 20,005,084 bytes. Marble and the ancient date describe the represented original, not the scanned plaster cast.
